content: ICU MessageFormat for a dependency-free t(): Intl.MessageFormat does not exist in Node 24 or Chromium (verified undefined), so a hand-rolled parser is required. Full ICU grammar (select, nested placeholders, offset) is a dependency in disguise; a bounded subset of {name} interpolation plus {count, plural, one{...} other{...}} is sufficient for en and fr (CLDR categories one/other, plus 'many' for fr at 1000000). Validate ICU syntax at build time (formatjs/cli catches mismatched braces); hand-rolled equivalent must validate placeholder parity between locale catalogues.
